model.name: R20.30: Traceability Chain ≠ All Children — they must show DIFFERENT content.
model.description: The detail view's 'Traceability Chain' section and 'All Children' section MUST show DIFFERENT content — currently they are IDENTICAL (same nodes). Traceability Chain = the FORWARD PRIMARY chain only (req→uc→class→method→impl→test→gate — the singular traced path). All Children = ALL child nodes from all model array relationships (the union). When a node has non-chain children (e.g. a Class with 5 methods but only 1 in the traced chain), Traceability Chain shows 1, All Children shows 5. Re-assertion of R20.5 (7734f4e1) which specified this but implementation still renders identical content.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (IMG_4060): Traceability Chain ≠ All Children — they must show DIFFERENT content (currently identical).
model.crossRefNote: R20.5 (universal chain-vs-children) defined this rule. R20.30 re-asserts it as a bug — implementation still renders both sections identically.
